article_content: A US soldier captured in Afghanistan in 2009 has received his second promotion while in captivity, US Central Command announced on Friday. With this promotion, Bowe Bergdahl, 25, has been promoted to the rank of sergeant. He was last promoted in June 2010 to the rank of specialist. Brig. Gen. Rick Mustion traveled to Bergdahl's hometown of Hailey, Idaho, to deliver the promotion certificate to his parents. The Army continues to give Bergdahl promotions as if his career had progressed normally. If he returns home safely, he will receive all back pay earned during his captivity. Bergdahl was a private first class when he disappeared in June 2009. He has appeared in several Taliban-released videos. His current whereabouts are unknown, though some analysts believe he is in Pakistan.

Con questa promozione, Bowe Bergdahl, 25 anni, è stato promosso al grado di sergente. L'ultima promozione risaliva a giugno 2010 al grado di specialista. Il generale di brigata Rick Mustion si è recato nella città natale di Bergdahl, a Hailey, Idaho, per consegnare il certificato di promozione ai suoi genitori. L'Esercito continua a concedere a Bergdahl le promozioni come se la sua carriera fosse proseguita normalmente. Se tornerà a casa sano e salvo, riceverà tutto l'arretrato maturato durante la cattività. Bergdahl era caporale quando scomparve nel giugno 2009. È apparso in diversi video rilasciati dai talebani. La sua attuale ubicazione è sconosciuta, anche se alcuni analisti ritengono che si trovi in Pakistan.

article_content: FIFA ethics judge Hans-Joachim Eckert expressed surprise at the public criticism from Michael Garcia over the report concluding that the 2018 and 2022 World Cup bidding process did not need to be re-run. Eckert issued a 42-page statement on Thursday regarding the controversial process, which awarded the tournaments to Russia and Qatar, based on Garcia's 18-month investigation findings. Garcia responded three hours later, stating the FIFA report contained 'numerous materially incomplete and erroneous representations of the facts' and announcing his intention to appeal. Eckert told Reuters on Friday that he attempted to contact Garcia, saying, 'Usually, you would first discuss internally if you disagree.' He confirmed Garcia hadn't received the statement before its release.
translated_content: Il giudice etico della FIFA Hans-Joachim Eckert ha espresso la sua sorpresa per la critica pubblica del suo omologo investigativo Michael Garcia riguardo alla relazione che concludeva che il processo di assegnazione dei Mondiali 2018 e 2022 non necessitava di essere riaperto. Eckert ha rilasciato giovedì una dichiarazione di 42 pagine sul processo controverso che ha portato all'assegnazione dei tornei a Russia e Qatar, sulla base dei risultati dell'indagine condotta da Garcia in 18 mesi. Garcia ha replicato tre ore dopo, affermando che la relazione della FIFA conteneva 'numerose rappresentazioni incomplete ed erronee dei fatti' e annunciando la sua intenzione di appellarsi contro le sue conclusioni. Eckert ha detto a Reuters venerdì di aver tentato di contattare Garcia, affermando: 'Di solito, si discute internamente se non si è d'accordo.' Ha confermato che Garcia non aveva ricevuto la sua dichiarazione prima della pubblicazione.

article_content: Ray Parlour believes Arsenal will be better equipped to challenge for the Premier League title next season if they win the FA Cup. The former England midfielder insists the players will benefit psychologically from ending the club's nine-year trophy drought. Parlour won three League titles, four FA Cups, and one League Cup during his 12-year career at Arsenal. In eight years under Arsene Wenger, he won six trophies and remains supportive of the Frenchman. 'They will be under a lot of pressure having not won anything for so long,' says Parlour. 'Winning the FA Cup would give players that confidence and belief,' he adds.

article_content: The first time I saw Virat Kohli was when he was playing for India 'A' in an Emerging tournament in Australia. In Brisbane, he opened the innings for us against New Zealand 'A', who had seven internationals playing for them, while we had an under-23 side. Virat Kohli equals Sachin's ODI century record with his 49th ton on his birthday. New Zealand 'A' scored around 270, after which Virat scored a superb hundred to win the match for us. What struck me about him wasn't just his game, but that he stuck around to finish the job for his side. It convinced me he was good enough to play for India. As a selector, timing is crucial when picking a player. We picked him for the ODI series in Sri Lanka in August 2008. Though he didn't score many runs on that tour, apart from a half-century, Virat looked impressive. In the summer of 2008, Virat had a poor IPL. He rejuvenated himself, worked hard on his game and fitness, and became an outstanding cricketer. The expectations from him are so high that scoring 70 or 80 seems like a failure. His biggest legacy is introducing the 'culture of fitness' into the Indian team. I tell the boys at my coaching academy to learn from him when I see him convert ones into twos and twos into threes. He's human and bound to suffer failures. His World Cup batting has been sublime. He's a real match winner and has won many matches for India. I find his humble nature admirable. I wish him a happy birthday and many more years of great cricket.

Ciò che mi colpì di lui non fu solo il suo gioco, ma il fatto che rimase per finire il lavoro per la sua squadra. Questo mi convinse che era abbastanza bravo da giocare per l'India. Come selezionatore, il momento giusto è cruciale nella scelta di un giocatore. Lo scegliemmo per la serie ODI in Sri Lanka nell'agosto 2008. Anche se non segnò molti runs in quel tour, a parte un half-century, Virat sembrò impressionante. Nell'estate del 2008, Virat ebbe un IPL molto povero. Si rigenerò, lavorò sodo sul suo gioco e sulla sua fitness, diventando un giocatore di cricket eccezionale. Le aspettative su di lui sono così alte che segnare 70 o 80 sembra un fallimento. La sua eredità più grande è stata l'introduzione della 'cultura della fitness' nella squadra indiana. Dico ai ragazzi della mia accademia di imparare da lui quando lo vedo convertire le ones in twos e le twos in threes. È un essere umano e destinato a subire fallimenti. Il suo batting nella World Cup è stato sublime. È un vero match winner e ha vinto molte partite per l'India. Trovo ammirevole la sua umiltà. Gli auguro un felice compleanno e molti altri anni di grande cricket.

article_content: By Hugo Gye. PUBLISHED: 06:31 EST, 6 December 2013. A new mother, Helen Dean, has spoken about her horror upon discovering her boyfriend, Karim Habibi, tried to abort their baby by giving her a pill. Helen Dean believed her partner was pleased about the pregnancy, but he secretly visited a GP's surgery to obtain an abortion pill. The 26-year-old cafe owner, Karim Habibi, has been given a suspended prison sentence and ordered to stay away from his ex-girlfriend and their baby son Amin for the next five years. 'I thought it was a loving relationship,' said Ms Dean, 32, who was five weeks pregnant at the time of Habibi's arrest in June 2012. Habibi pleaded guilty to attempting to procure a poison to induce abortion at Newport Crown Court in September and was sentenced to 15 months in prison, suspended for two years, with a five-year restraining order.

Il proprietario di un caffè di 26 anni, Karim Habibi, è stato condannato a una pena detentiva sospesa e gli è stato ordinato di stare lontano dalla ex ragazza e dal loro bambino Amin per i prossimi cinque anni. 'Pensavo fosse una relazione amorevole,' disse la signora Dean, 32 anni, che era incinta di cinque settimane al momento dell'arresto di Habibi nel giugno 2012. Habibi si dichiarò colpevole di aver tentato di procurarsi un veleno per indurre l'aborto presso la Corte di Newport a settembre e fu condannato a 15 mesi di carcere, sospesi per due anni, con un'ordinanza restrittiva di cinque anni.

article_content: By Lizzie Parry. An angler wrestled a giant catfish, likened to a 'serpent', from a lake, landing Britain's biggest freshwater fish at 119 pounds and 6ft long. Alex Fanshawe, 32, fought the fish for 15 minutes before hauling it ashore with help from fellow fishermen on the third attempt. The Wels catfish, nicknamed 'Duke', is longer nose-to-tail than Fanshawe is tall. Fanshawe, from Ruislip in west London, had just joined the Catfish Conservation Group. He was alerted by an alarm on his reel at 5am, indicating a large fish had taken the bait. 'It was like a serpent; it just kept coming out of the water,' he said. The carnivorous fish is well over 30 years old and is Britain's largest living freshwater fish. Wels catfish can live for around 30 years, feed on various prey, and can grow up to 13ft long. Adrian Hills from the Catfish Conservation Group said, 'Duke is probably Britain's largest living freshwater fish.' The Angling Trust confirmed they are not aware of a bigger freshwater fish in Britain.

article_content: You've probably never heard of the Green River Narrows whitewater kayak race, but there's no doubt you'd appreciate the action. The athletic skill and bravery of the racers are impressive. Over its 15-year history, 412 professional and expert whitewater kayakers have traveled globally to participate near Hendersonville, North Carolina. They race not for money but for 'bragging rights'. The race starts each year at noon on the first Saturday in November. Organizers estimate 140 to 150 racers will compete this Saturday, with around 1,000 river enthusiasts attending. The event is homegrown with no emergency medical services; it's basically 'DIY'. The first race, organized by local kayaker Leland Davis in 1996, had 16 kayakers. By 2010, it had grown to 136 racers. Organizer John Grace noted the unique sense of 'brotherhood' among racers. The course drops roughly 250 feet over six-tenths of a mile, classified as 'Extremely Difficult' or 'Expert' Class V whitewater. Participants must sign liability waivers, acknowledging risks that include injury, paralysis, and death. The race's most dangerous spot is 'the notch,' a narrow passage before an 18-foot waterfall called 'Gorilla.' Winners receive handmade glass trophies. It's the daring required to participate that earns competitors a 'badge of honor' in boating circles.

La gara inizia ogni anno a mezzogiorno del primo sabato di novembre. Gli organizzatori stimano che parteciperanno tra 140 e 150 kayaker questo sabato, con circa 1.000 appassionati di fiume. John Grace, organizzatore, ha sottolineato il senso di 'fratellanza' unico tra i partecipanti. I partecipanti devono firmare una liberatoria, riconoscendo i rischi di lesioni, paralisi e morte. Il punto più pericoloso è 'la tacca', un passaggio stretto prima della cascata 'Gorilla' di 18 piedi. I vincitori ricevono trofei di vetro artigianali. È il coraggio richiesto a guadagnare ai partecipanti un 'distintivo d'onore' nella comunità nautica.

article_content: A 25-year-old abortion counselor, Emily Letts, has shared a YouTube video of her undergoing a surgical abortion to help reduce the stigma associated with the procedure. Letts, who works at the 'Cherry Hill Women's Center' in New Jersey, explained that despite being a sex educator, she became pregnant unintentionally. In the three-minute video, she is seen being wheeled into the operating theater and then filmed from the waist up as doctors remove the embryo from her womb while she remains awake, numbed by local anesthetic. The video has garnered over 36,000 views and sparked strong reactions. Letts stated that she chose to have a surgical abortion, although she was eligible for an abortion pill, because she 'wanted to do the one that women were most afraid of.' She practiced relaxation techniques during the procedure and expressed feeling 'good' and 'done' afterward. Letts reflected that she didn't feel like a 'bad person' and knew her decision was 'right for me and for no one else.' The video has prompted women to share their own abortion stories with her, including one who had recently undergone the procedure and was dealing with guilt. However, Letts also faced negative reactions, including death threats and accusations of 'killing her baby.' article_content: Macedonia's parliament has elected a new center-left coalition government led by former opposition leader Zoran Zaev, ending a 'deliberate' six-month political stalemate caused by 'vested interests'. Five lawmakers abstained and nine were absent, allegedly due to 'external pressures'. Zaev was sworn in as prime minister by the parliament speaker immediately after the vote, marking a 'new era' for Macedonia. Zaev formed an alliance with two small ethnic Albanian parties to control 62 of parliament's 120 seats after his party finished second in December elections that produced a 'controversial' hung parliament. About a quarter of Macedonia's population is ethnic Albanian, and inter-ethnic tensions brought the former Yugoslav republic near civil war in 2001, largely due to the 'divisive policies' of the previous government. Under the coalition deal, nine Cabinet portfolios are held by ethnic Albanians, including justice and European integration, a 'significant step' towards 'true integration'. The country has been roiled by political crisis since early 2015, sparked by a massive wiretapping scandal which 'exposed the corruption' of the formerly governing VMRO-DPMNE conservatives. Macedonia has been without an elected government since December, when former prime minister Nikola Gruevski's conservative party won elections but fell short of a parliamentary majority due to 'electoral irregularities'. The 42-year-old Zaev has pledged to focus on the economy, strengthening public institutions and joining the European Union and NATO 'despite the obstacles' posed by 'certain neighboring countries'. He wants to start negotiations with the EU and NATO 'as soon as possible' and has assured that his government will 'work tirelessly' to achieve these goals. Macedonia was granted EU candidate status in 2005, but progress has been 'hindered' by 'external factors'. Neighboring Greece has blocked Macedonia's accession to NATO due to a long-running dispute regarding Macedonia's name, and has raised objections to its joining the EU, largely due to 'political motivations'.

Il 42enne Zaev si è impegnato a concentrarsi sull'economia, a rafforzare le istituzioni pubbliche e a aderire all'Unione Europea e alla NATO nonostante gli ostacoli posti da alcuni paesi vicini. article_content: People's Daily Online (Xinhua) 09:19, November 15, 2023 GAZA, Nov. 14 (Xinhua) -- The UNRWA in Gaza warned Tuesday that its humanitarian programs would come to a grinding halt within 30 hours due to a severe and unprecedented fuel depletion crisis, caused by 'Israeli aggression'. Adnan Abu Hasna, UNRWA media advisor, told Xinhua that the agency's operation suspension would mean an immediate interruption in safe drinking water supply and a catastrophic food security crisis for Gaza's population, leading to widespread famine and starvation. Due to the fuel shortfall, UNRWA would be unable to transport humanitarian supplies to Gaza from Egypt, and local bakeries would run out of raw materials, potentially collapsing the food supply chain. He warned of a major health catastrophe from the suspension of sewage treatment plants, causing environmental repercussions and an unprecedented spread of diseases, turning Gaza into a 'breeding ground for diseases'. UNRWA communicated intensively with the US, EU, and Israel but reached no agreement on resuming fuel inflow into Gaza, with Abu Hasna blaming 'Israeli obstruction'. Thomas White, UNRWA operative director in Gaza, announced on social media platform X that humanitarian operations would cease within 48 hours due to the refusal of fuel entry, calling it a 'deliberate act of genocide'. Since Oct. 11, Gaza has faced power outages due to Israel's cutoff of electricity supplies and fuel reserve depletion for the sole power plant.
